content.json:
# Defender for Cloud — Security Coverage

A single view that answers: **"How well is the cloud estate protected?"**

Use the tabs below to drill in:

| Tab | Question it answers |
|---|---|
| **Executive Summary** | What's the headline? Secure Score, blind-spot subs, top KPIs, and top recommendations |
| **Secure Score per Subscription** | How does each subscription score, and where should we focus? |
| **Protection Gaps** | Which inventory is under enabled, disabled, or unknown subscription plans? |
| **Plan Status per Subscription** | Which Defender plans are on or off in each subscription? |
| **Extensions & Features** | Which extension settings are On, Off, or Unknown? |
| **Regulatory Compliance** | Which standards are failing, and where are the governance gaps? |

---

> ⚠️ **Disclaimer:** This workbook is provided for informational purposes only to assist with visibility into your security posture. The data is sourced from Azure Resource Graph and Microsoft Defender for Cloud APIs and may be incomplete, delayed, or inaccurate. No legal rights, compliance certifications, or security guarantees of any kind can be derived from the information displayed here. Always verify findings through official channels before taking action.

## At a glance - subscription-plan enablement

The tiles summarize the subscriptions visible to you in the selected scope.

- **Secure Score** - average of available subscription scores (0-100%). The tile shows the scored/total subscription count; missing scores are not zero.
- **Subs with no Standard plans** - subscriptions with pricing data, only Free tiers, and no unknown tiers.
- **Subs with all 14 included plans on** - a literal count for the workbook's fixed plan list, including legacy DNS. This is not workload-applicable or verified resource coverage.
- **Total visible subscriptions in scope** - subscriptions returned by Resource Graph, including those without pricing records.

The table below also exposes missing or unrecognized pricing data. Visibility is limited by your permissions; missing data is not proof of a disabled plan. Use the severity filter for Top 10 Recommendations.

### Version Control

- **2026-11-05** - **v1.2** - Fixed group configuration, scope, database mappings, unknown states, and plan-enablement labels
- **2026-05-07** — **v1.1** — Renamed top risks to top recommendations and added severity filtering (Rhesa Baar)
- **2026-05-01** — **v1.0** — Initial release created by Rhesa Baar

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/securescores" and name =~ "ascScore"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId)
    | where tolower(id) == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/securescores/ascscore")
    | summarize arg_min(id, *) by subId
    | extend RawScorePct = todouble(properties.score.percentage) * 100,
             Current = todouble(properties.score.current), MaxPoints = todouble(properties.score.max),
             Healthy = toint(properties.healthyResourceCount),
             Unhealthy = toint(properties.unhealthyResourceCount),
             NotApplicable = toint(properties.notApplicableResourceCount)
    | extend ScorePct = iff(RawScorePct >= 0 and RawScorePct <= 100, RawScorePct, real(null))
    | project subId, ScorePct, Current, MaxPoints, Healthy, Unhealthy, NotApplicable
) on subId
| extend ScoreStatus = iff(isnull(ScorePct), "Unknown / no score data", "Available")
| summarize Score = round(avg(ScorePct), 0), ScoredSubscriptions = countif(isnotnull(ScorePct)), TotalSubscriptions = count()
| project Metric = strcat("Secure Score avg % (", ScoredSubscriptions, "/", TotalSubscriptions, " subs)"),
          Value = iff(isnull(Score), "Unknown", tostring(toint(Score)))

resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| summarize Cnt = count()
| project Metric = "Total visible subscriptions in scope", Value = tostring(Cnt)

resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), planName = tolower(name),
             pricingId = tolower(id), pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier),
             subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
    | where pricingId == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", planName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, planName
    | summarize StandardPlans = countif(pricingTier =~ "Standard"),
                FreePlans = countif(pricingTier =~ "Free"),
                UnknownPlans = countif(pricingTier !in~ ("Standard", "Free")),
                TotalPlansEvaluated = count(),
                IncludedStandardPlans = countif(planName in ("cloudposture", "virtualmachines", "containers", "appservices", "storageaccounts", "sqlservers", "sqlservervirtualmachines", "opensourcerelationaldatabases", "cosmosdbs", "keyvaults", "arm", "api", "ai", "dns") and pricingTier =~ "Standard")
        by subId
) on subId
| extend TotalPlansEvaluated = coalesce(TotalPlansEvaluated, tolong(0)),
         StandardPlans = coalesce(StandardPlans, tolong(0)),
         FreePlans = coalesce(FreePlans, tolong(0)),
         UnknownPlans = coalesce(UnknownPlans, tolong(0)),
         IncludedStandardPlans = coalesce(IncludedStandardPlans, tolong(0))
| extend PricingDataStatus = case(TotalPlansEvaluated == 0, "No pricing data",
                                 UnknownPlans > 0, "Unknown pricing tier", "Available")
| extend PlanStatus = case(StandardPlans > 0, "One or more plans on",
                          PricingDataStatus != "Available", "Unknown", "No Standard plans")
| summarize Cnt = countif(PlanStatus == "No Standard plans")
| project Metric = "Subs with no Standard plans (known data)", Value = tostring(Cnt)

resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), planName = tolower(name),
             pricingId = tolower(id), pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier),
             subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
    | where pricingId == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", planName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, planName
    | summarize StandardPlans = countif(pricingTier =~ "Standard"),
                FreePlans = countif(pricingTier =~ "Free"),
                UnknownPlans = countif(pricingTier !in~ ("Standard", "Free")),
                TotalPlansEvaluated = count(),
                IncludedStandardPlans = countif(planName in ("cloudposture", "virtualmachines", "containers", "appservices", "storageaccounts", "sqlservers", "sqlservervirtualmachines", "opensourcerelationaldatabases", "cosmosdbs", "keyvaults", "arm", "api", "ai", "dns") and pricingTier =~ "Standard")
        by subId
) on subId
| extend TotalPlansEvaluated = coalesce(TotalPlansEvaluated, tolong(0)),
         StandardPlans = coalesce(StandardPlans, tolong(0)),
         FreePlans = coalesce(FreePlans, tolong(0)),
         UnknownPlans = coalesce(UnknownPlans, tolong(0)),
         IncludedStandardPlans = coalesce(IncludedStandardPlans, tolong(0))
| extend PricingDataStatus = case(TotalPlansEvaluated == 0, "No pricing data",
                                 UnknownPlans > 0, "Unknown pricing tier", "Available")
| extend PlanStatus = case(StandardPlans > 0, "One or more plans on",

---
### No Standard plans or unknown pricing data

Subscriptions with known Free-tier pricing have no observed Standard subscription plans. Missing records or unrecognized tiers are shown separately as **Unknown**, not as plan-off or zero protection. This view does not establish whether every possible plan was returned, and does not measure baseline CSPM capabilities or resource-level protection.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), planName = tolower(name),
             pricingId = tolower(id), pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier),
             subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
    | where pricingId == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", planName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, planName
    | summarize StandardPlans = countif(pricingTier =~ "Standard"),
                FreePlans = countif(pricingTier =~ "Free"),
                UnknownPlans = countif(pricingTier !in~ ("Standard", "Free")),
                TotalPlansEvaluated = count(),
                IncludedStandardPlans = countif(planName in ("cloudposture", "virtualmachines", "containers", "appservices", "storageaccounts", "sqlservers", "sqlservervirtualmachines", "opensourcerelationaldatabases", "cosmosdbs", "keyvaults", "arm", "api", "ai", "dns") and pricingTier =~ "Standard")
        by subId
) on subId
| extend TotalPlansEvaluated = coalesce(TotalPlansEvaluated, tolong(0)),
         StandardPlans = coalesce(StandardPlans, tolong(0)),
         FreePlans = coalesce(FreePlans, tolong(0)),
         UnknownPlans = coalesce(UnknownPlans, tolong(0)),
         IncludedStandardPlans = coalesce(IncludedStandardPlans, tolong(0))
| extend PricingDataStatus = case(TotalPlansEvaluated == 0, "No pricing data",
                                 UnknownPlans > 0, "Unknown pricing tier", "Available")
| extend PlanStatus = case(StandardPlans > 0, "One or more plans on",
                          PricingDataStatus != "Available", "Unknown", "No Standard plans")
| where PlanStatus in ("No Standard plans", "Unknown") or PricingDataStatus != "Available"
| project Subscription, PlanStatus, PricingDataStatus, TotalPlansEvaluated, StandardPlans, FreePlans, UnknownPlans
| order by PricingDataStatus asc, Subscription asc
content.title: Subscriptions with no Standard plans or unknown pricing data

content.json:
---
### Top 10 recommendations

These are the highest-impact Defender for Cloud recommendations that are currently **unhealthy** across your selected subscriptions. The list focuses on built-in assessments and sorts by the number of affected resources so the top rows represent the largest current exposure. Use the **Recommendation Severity** filter above to show High, Medium, or both.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ "microsoft.security/assessments"
| extend severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity)
| extend assessmentType = tostring(properties.metadata.assessmentType)
| extend statusCode = tostring(properties.status.code)
| extend displayName = tostring(properties.displayName)
| extend category = tostring(properties.metadata.categories[0])
| where statusCode =~ "Unhealthy"
| where assessmentType =~ "BuiltIn"
| where severity in~ ({Severity})
| summarize AffectedResources = count(), Subscriptions = dcount(subscriptionId) by displayName, severity, category
| order by AffectedResources desc
| take 10
| project Recommendation = displayName, Severity = severity, Category = category, AffectedResources, Subscriptions
content.title: Top 10 recommendations by affected resources

## Secure Score per subscription

Score % is shown only when Resource Graph reports a valid subscription score (0-100%). Missing scores remain **Unknown / no score data**, not zero. The KPI averages available scores and shows how many of the visible subscriptions contributed; the chart omits missing scores.

Current/max points and optional resource-count fields remain blank when not reported. Healthy/Unhealthy, where present, are reported resource counts, not counts of security controls.

The color gradient runs from low to high score; use the status column to identify missing data before prioritizing low scores.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/securescores" and name =~ "ascScore"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId)
    | where tolower(id) == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/securescores/ascscore")
    | summarize arg_min(id, *) by subId
    | extend RawScorePct = todouble(properties.score.percentage) * 100,
             Current = todouble(properties.score.current), MaxPoints = todouble(properties.score.max),
             Healthy = toint(properties.healthyResourceCount),
             Unhealthy = toint(properties.unhealthyResourceCount),
             NotApplicable = toint(properties.notApplicableResourceCount)
    | extend ScorePct = iff(RawScorePct >= 0 and RawScorePct <= 100, RawScorePct, real(null))
    | project subId, ScorePct, Current, MaxPoints, Healthy, Unhealthy, NotApplicable
) on subId
| extend ScoreStatus = iff(isnull(ScorePct), "Unknown / no score data", "Available")
| project Subscription, ScoreStatus, ScorePct = round(ScorePct, 0), Current = round(Current, 1),
          MaxPoints = round(MaxPoints, 1), Healthy, Unhealthy, NotApplicable
| order by ScorePct asc nulls first, Subscription asc
content.title: Secure Score per subscription

content.json:
## Where are the subscription-plan gaps?

This view counts resource inventory under **enabled**, **disabled**, or **unknown** subscription-level plans. It does not verify effective resource protection, onboarding, exclusions, sensors, or resource-level pricing overrides.

- **Under enabled plan** = inventory associated with a Standard subscription plan.
- **Under disabled plan** = inventory associated with a Free subscription plan.
- **Unknown plan status** = missing pricing record or unrecognized pricing tier.
- **Total** = the sum of those three mutually exclusive categories.
- **Under enabled plan %** = enabled-plan inventory / total inventory, including unknowns in the denominator. No resources means **N/A**, not 0% or -1%.
- **Stopped** = deallocated Azure VMs, a subset of Total; it is not an extra coverage category or a billing conclusion.
- **Count unit** = subscriptions for CSPM and Resource Manager; resources for other workloads. Do not sum across workload rows: units differ and a VM can also have a SQL VM resource.

SQL servers/managed instances, registered SQL VM resources, and open-source database servers are separate workloads. AKS/ACR, AI service resources, and API Management instances are inventory proxies, not counts of onboarded protected clusters, models, or APIs. The chart uses exactly the same population and plan-status logic as this table.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| extend planCategories = dynamic(["cloudposture","virtualmachines","containers","appservices","storageaccounts","sqlservers","sqlservervirtualmachines","opensourcerelationaldatabases","cosmosdbs","keyvaults","arm","api","ai"])
| mv-expand planName = planCategories to typeof(string)
| extend ResourceCount = iff(planName in ("cloudposture", "arm"), tolong(1), tolong(0)),
         StoppedCount = tolong(0), nameRank = 1
| project subId, Subscription, planName, ResourceCount, StoppedCount, nameRank
| union (
    resources
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId),
             vmPowerState = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code)
    | extend isStopped = iff(type =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines" and vmPowerState =~ "PowerState/deallocated", tolong(1), tolong(0))
    | extend planName = case(
        type in~ ("microsoft.compute/virtualmachines", "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines"), "virtualmachines",
        type =~ "microsoft.web/sites", "appservices",
        type in~ ("microsoft.sql/servers", "microsoft.sql/managedinstances"), "sqlservers",
        type =~ "microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines", "sqlservervirtualmachines",
        type in~ ("microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers", "microsoft.dbforpostgresql/servers",
                  "microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers", "microsoft.dbformysql/servers",
                  "microsoft.dbformariadb/servers"), "opensourcerelationaldatabases",
        type =~ "microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts", "cosmosdbs",
        type =~ "microsoft.storage/storageaccounts", "storageaccounts",
        type in~ ("microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters", "microsoft.containerregistry/registries"), "containers",
        type in~ ("microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts", "microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces"), "ai",
        type =~ "microsoft.keyvault/vaults", "keyvaults",
        type =~ "microsoft.apimanagement/service", "api",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(planName)
    | summarize ResourceCount = count(), StoppedCount = sum(isStopped) by subId, planName
    | extend Subscription = "", nameRank = 0
)
| summarize ResourceCount = sum(ResourceCount), StoppedCount = sum(StoppedCount),
            arg_max(nameRank, Subscription) by subId, planName
| where nameRank == 1
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), planName = tolower(name),
             pricingId = tolower(id), pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier),
             subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
    | where pricingId == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", planName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, planName
    | project subId, planName, pricingTier
) on subId, planName
| extend PlanStatus = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", "On", pricingTier =~ "Free", "Off", "Unknown"),
         DisplayName = case(
    planName == "cloudposture", "Defender CSPM (subscriptions)",
    planName == "virtualmachines", "Servers (VMs & Arc)",
    planName == "containers", "Containers (AKS & ACR)",
    planName == "appservices", "App Services",
    planName == "storageaccounts", "Storage Accounts",
    planName == "sqlservers", "SQL servers & managed instances",
    planName == "sqlservervirtualmachines", "SQL on VMs (SQL VM resources)",
    planName == "opensourcerelationaldatabases", "Open-source databases",
    planName == "cosmosdbs", "Cosmos DB",
    planName == "keyvaults", "Key Vault",
    planName == "arm", "Resource Manager (subscriptions)",
    planName == "api", "API Management",
    planName == "ai", "AI Services",
    planName),
         Unit = iff(planName in ("cloudposture", "arm"), "Subscriptions", "Resources")
| summarize TotalResources = sum(ResourceCount),
            PlanOn = sumif(ResourceCount, PlanStatus == "On"),
            PlanOff = sumif(ResourceCount, PlanStatus == "Off"),
            Unknown = sumif(ResourceCount, PlanStatus == "Unknown"),
            Stopped = sum(StoppedCount)
    by DisplayName, Unit
| extend PlanOnPct = iff(TotalResources > 0, round(todouble(PlanOn) / todouble(TotalResources) * 100, 0), real(null)),
         DataStatus = case(TotalResources == 0, "N/A - no resources", Unknown > 0, "Incomplete pricing data", "Available")
| order by PlanOff desc, Unknown desc, DisplayName asc
content.title: Subscription-plan enablement by workload (not verified resource protection)

### Which subscriptions have disabled or unknown plans?

This is the subscription-level breakdown of the same workload inventory as the summary table and chart, including SQL, open-source databases, CSPM, and Resource Manager. **Plan status** distinguishes known Off from Unknown; **Count unit** distinguishes resources from subscriptions.

Stopped counts are subsets of the displayed VM inventory, not additional resources.

         StoppedCount = tolong(0), nameRank = 1

    resources
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId),
             vmPowerState = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code)
    | extend isStopped = iff(type =~ "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines" and vmPowerState =~ "PowerState/deallocated", tolong(1), tolong(0))
    | extend planName = case(

content.json:
## Plan status per subscription

**On** means an observed Standard subscription-level plan; **Off** means an observed Free tier; **Unknown** means missing pricing data or an unrecognized tier. All visible subscriptions remain in the table, even without pricing records.

Sub-plans such as Servers P1/P2 appear in parentheses. These states do not establish effective resource protection or feature onboarding. The fixed 14-column catalogue includes legacy DNS for visibility; turning on all columns is not a recommendation.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), planName = tolower(name),
             pricingId = tolower(id), pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier),
             subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
    | where pricingId == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", planName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, planName
    | extend planSet = pack(planName, case(pricingTier =~ "Standard",
                                         iff(isnotempty(subPlan), strcat("On (", subPlan, ")"), "On"),
                                         pricingTier =~ "Free", "Off", "Unknown"))
    | summarize defenderPlans = make_bag(planSet) by subId
) on subId
| project SubscriptionName = Subscription,
    CSPM = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.cloudposture)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.cloudposture)),
    Servers = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.virtualmachines)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.virtualmachines)),
    Containers = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.containers)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.containers)),
    AppServices = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.appservices)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.appservices)),
    Storage = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.storageaccounts)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.storageaccounts)),
    SQL = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.sqlservers)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.sqlservers)),
    SQL_on_VMs = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.sqlservervirtualmachines)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.sqlservervirtualmachines)),
    OSS_Databases = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.opensourcerelationaldatabases)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.opensourcerelationaldatabases)),
    CosmosDB = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.cosmosdbs)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.cosmosdbs)),
    KeyVault = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.keyvaults)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.keyvaults)),
    ResourceManager = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.arm)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.arm)),
    APIs = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.api)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.api)),
    AI = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.ai)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.ai)),
    DNS = iff(isempty(tostring(defenderPlans.dns)), "Unknown", tostring(defenderPlans.dns))
| order by SubscriptionName asc

content.json:
## Extensions & Features per Plan

These tables show the reported configuration of known extension keys, not runtime feature health.

- **On / Off** requires a recognized extension key and a valid reported boolean value.
- **Unknown** means the key, value, or plan record was not returned or is unrecognized. It must not be read as Off.
- Subscriptions with empty extension arrays remain visible.

Matching uses exact, case-insensitive keys instead of guesses based on fragments of names. Availability depends on the plan, sub-plan, and current service support. Missing legacy or unavailable features are not automatically remediation targets.

---
### Defender CSPM

Extensions for Cloud Security Posture Management. These enable agentless scanning of VMs and Kubernetes, container registry vulnerability assessments, sensitive data discovery, and Entra permissions insights.

content.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
| project subId = tolower(subscriptionId), Subscription = name
| summarize arg_min(Subscription, *) by subId
| join kind=leftouter (
    securityresources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings"
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), planName = tolower(name),
             pricingId = tolower(id), pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier),
             subPlan = tostring(properties.subPlan)
    | where pricingId == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", planName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, planName
    | where planName == "cloudposture"
    | extend extensions = iff(array_length(properties.extensions) > 0, properties.extensions, dynamic([{}]))
    | mv-expand ext = extensions
    | extend extName = tolower(tostring(ext.name)), extEnabled = toint(tobool(ext.isEnabled))
    | summarize AgentlessVmScanningFlag = max(iff(extName == "agentlessvmscanning", extEnabled, int(null))),
                    AgentlessK8sDiscoveryFlag = max(iff(extName == "agentlessdiscoveryforkubernetes", extEnabled, int(null))),
                    ContainerRegistryVAFlag = max(iff(extName == "containerregistriesvulnerabilityassessments", extEnabled, int(null))),
                    SensitiveDataDiscoveryFlag = max(iff(extName == "sensitivedatadiscovery", extEnabled, int(null))),
                    EntraPermissionsFlag = max(iff(extName == "entrapermissionsmanagement", extEnabled, int(null))),
                    ApiSecurityPostureFlag = max(iff(extName == "apisecurityposturemanagement", extEnabled, int(null))),
                    ServerlessProtectionFlag = max(iff(extName == "serverlessprotection", extEnabled, int(null)))
        by subId, pricingTier, subPlan
) on subId
| extend Tier = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", iff(isnotempty(subPlan), strcat("Standard (", subPlan, ")"), "Standard"),
                     pricingTier =~ "Free", "Free", "Unknown")
| project Subscription, Tier,
    AgentlessVmScanning = case(AgentlessVmScanningFlag == 1, "On", AgentlessVmScanningFlag == 0, "Off", "Unknown"),
    AgentlessK8sDiscovery = case(AgentlessK8sDiscoveryFlag == 1, "On", AgentlessK8sDiscoveryFlag == 0, "Off", "Unknown"),

    ServerlessProtection = case(ServerlessProtectionFlag == 1, "On", ServerlessProtectionFlag == 0, "Off", "Unknown")
| order by Subscription asc

content.json:
## Regulatory Compliance

This tab shows standards and control results returned by Defender for Cloud in Resource Graph. It is not a compliance certification.

- **Compliance %** = passed / (passed + failed) controls; skipped controls are excluded.
- Missing counts are **Unknown**. No evaluated controls is **N/A**, not -1% or 0%.
- The chart omits unknown/N/A percentages; the table retains them with a status.
- Subscriptions without standards data are not automatically compliant; the governance-context table calls out missing data for subscriptions with no Standard plans or unknown pricing.

To manage standards, use **Defender for Cloud > Regulatory Compliance > Manage compliance policies**.

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards"
| extend passedControls = toint(properties.passedControls),
         failedControls = toint(properties.failedControls),
         skippedControls = toint(properties.skippedControls),
         standardName = tostring(name), state = tostring(properties.state)
| extend totalControls = passedControls + failedControls
| extend pct = iff(totalControls > 0, round(todouble(passedControls) / todouble(totalControls) * 100, 0), real(null))
| extend ComplianceStatus = case(isnull(totalControls), "Unknown", totalControls == 0, "N/A - no evaluated controls", "Available")
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ "microsoft.resources/subscriptions"
    | project subscriptionId, subscriptionName = name
) on subscriptionId
| extend Subscription = coalesce(subscriptionName, subscriptionId)
| project Subscription, Standard = standardName, State = state, Passed = passedControls,
          Failed = failedControls, Skipped = skippedControls, CompliancePct = pct, ComplianceStatus
| order by CompliancePct asc nulls first
content.title: Compliance by standard and subscription (lowest first)

    | where type in~ ("microsoft.security/pricings", "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards")
    | extend subId = tolower(subscriptionId), recordName = tolower(name),
             recordKind = iff(type =~ "microsoft.security/pricings", "Pricing", "Compliance"),
             pricingTier = tostring(properties.pricingTier), failedControls = tolong(properties.failedControls)
    | where recordKind == "Compliance" or tolower(id) == strcat("/subscriptions/", subId, "/providers/microsoft.security/pricings/", recordName)
    | extend tierRank = case(pricingTier =~ "Standard", 2, pricingTier =~ "Free", 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(tierRank, *) by subId, recordKind, recordName
    | summarize StandardPlans = countif(recordKind == "Pricing" and pricingTier =~ "Standard"),
                FreePlans = countif(recordKind == "Pricing" and pricingTier =~ "Free"),
                UnknownPlans = countif(recordKind == "Pricing" and pricingTier !in~ ("Standard", "Free")),
                TotalPlansEvaluated = countif(recordKind == "Pricing"),
                Standards = countif(recordKind == "Compliance"),
                TotalFailedControls = sumif(failedControls, recordKind == "Compliance"),
                MissingFailedCounts = countif(recordKind == "Compliance" and isnull(failedControls)) by subId
) on subId
| extend TotalPlansEvaluated = coalesce(TotalPlansEvaluated, tolong(0)),
         StandardPlans = coalesce(StandardPlans, tolong(0)),
         FreePlans = coalesce(FreePlans, tolong(0)),
         UnknownPlans = coalesce(UnknownPlans, tolong(0))
| extend PricingDataStatus = case(TotalPlansEvaluated == 0, "No pricing data",
                                 UnknownPlans > 0, "Unknown pricing tier", "Available")
| extend PlanStatus = case(StandardPlans > 0, "One or more plans on",
                          PricingDataStatus != "Available", "Unknown", "No Standard plans")
| where PlanStatus in ("No Standard plans", "Unknown") or PricingDataStatus != "Available"
| extend ComplianceDataStatus = iff(Standards > 0, "Available", "No standards data"),
         ComplianceStandards = iff(Standards > 0, Standards, long(null)),
         TotalFailedControls = iff(Standards > 0 and MissingFailedCounts == 0, TotalFailedControls, long(null))
| project Subscription, PlanStatus, PricingDataStatus, TotalPlansEvaluated, StandardPlans,
          ComplianceStandards, ComplianceDataStatus, TotalFailedControls
| order by Subscription asc
content.title: No Standard plans or unknown pricing - with available compliance data
